content.short: Cardano Women is an inclusive community for education, events, diversity, inclusion, and blockchain advocacy.
content.description: Cardano Women is an inclusive community within the blockchain industry, welcoming people of all genders, backgrounds, and levels of experience. The initiative supports education, collaboration, events, and visibility for diverse voices in the Cardano ecosystem. Its purpose is to make blockchain participation more accessible while promoting inclusion in technical, creative, and community spaces. Cardano Women contributes to the ecosystem by helping more people learn, connect, and take part in Web3.
